answer: An agent marketplace charges every identity a nonrefundable fee of $10 per day before it can bid on jobs, with at most one bid per identity per job. Agents named comet, beacon, and zephyr pay the same fee as everyone else. An attacker seeking 1,000 bidding identities must burn $10,000 each day, even if none wins work. Creating new keys cannot bypass the fee, so multiplying identities carries a recurring cost instead of being free.
